entries.name: aizynthfinder
entries.description: Expert agent for retrosynthetic route planning using AiZynthFinder. Breaks down target drug-like molecules into purchasable precursors using neural-network-guided MCTS with USPTO reaction templates.

entries.name: alphafold
entries.description: Agent for protein structure prediction using AlphaFold. Supports monomer and multimer folding, pLDDT and PAE quality assessment, FASTA input handling, and structure analysis for proteins and protein complexes.

entries.name: alphafold-db
entries.description: Retrieve precomputed protein structure predictions and confidence scores from the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database (no inference).

entries.name: ambertools
entries.description: Expert agent for biomolecular simulations using AmberTools (sander, tleap, cpptraj, antechamber).

entries.name: ase
entries.description: Workflow layer for atomistic simulations. Builds, manipulates, and optimizes atomic structures and orchestrates calculators, with a built-in EMT potential for fast CPU relaxations.

entries.name: autodock
entries.description: Expert molecular docking agent using AutoDock Vina for protein-ligand binding affinity prediction, virtual screening, and structure-based drug design.

entries.name: bindingdb
entries.description: BindingDB agent for retrieving comprehensive binding affinity data for protein-ligand interactions. Provides access to local SQLite database with sub-millisecond query performance.

entries.name: biopython
entries.description: Foundational bioinformatics toolkit for sequence I/O and analysis: parse FASTA/GenBank/PDB, compute sequence statistics, translate, and manipulate biological sequences.

entries.name: blast-plus
entries.description: Local sequence similarity search using the NCBI BLAST+ suite. Build custom databases and run blastn/blastp/blastx against them entirely offline.

entries.name: boltzgen
entries.description: Expert agent for protein binder design using the BoltzGen diffusion pipeline. Generates, folds, scores, and ranks binder designs using Boltz-2 for structure prediction and filtering.

entries.name: boltztwo
entries.description: Expert agent for biomolecular structure prediction and binding affinity estimation using Boltz-2. Predicts 3D structures of proteins, nucleic acids, small molecules, and their complexes via co-folding. Features an affinity head that estimates binder probability and pIC50 for protein-ligand and protein-protein interactions. Outputs CIF structures with per-residue confidence (pLDDT), predicted aligned error (pAE), and interface metrics (pTM, iPTM).

entries.name: bookshelf-researcher
entries.description: Expert research agent for conducting literature reviews and research analyses using attached Knowledge Bases / Bookshelves as the evidence source. LLM-only agent with no attached computation tools.

entries.name: cantera
entries.description: Chemical kinetics, thermodynamics, and transport for combustion and reacting flows. Compute equilibria and simulate reactors on CPU.

entries.name: chemberta
entries.description: Molecular property prediction agent using ChemBERTa-2 transformer. Provides SMILES-based molecular embeddings, classification and regression fine-tuning, SMILES augmentation, confidence scoring, similarity search, and clustering.

entries.name: chembl
entries.description: ChEMBL agent for retrieving chemical and bioactivity data from the ChEMBL database. Provides access to compound information, target data, bioactivity measurements, and cross-references with PDB structures.

entries.name: chemprop
entries.description: Expert agent for molecular property prediction using Chemprop v2 (D-MPNN). Trains, evaluates, and deploys message-passing neural networks for regression, classification, and multi-task molecular property prediction.

entries.name: clinical-trials
entries.description: Tool for accessing clinical trial data from ClinicalTrials.gov. Access over 400,000 clinical studies from around the world.

entries.name: cobrapy
entries.description: Constraint-based reconstruction and analysis of genome-scale metabolic models: flux-balance analysis, FVA, and gene knockouts.

entries.name: coconut
entries.description: Agent for searching and retrieving natural product structures from the COCONUT (Collection of Open Natural Products) database. Provides access to natural product chemical data, molecular properties, and taxonomic classifications.

entries.name: copasi-basico
entries.description: Simulation and analysis of biochemical reaction networks via COPASI through the basico Python interface: time- courses, steady states, and parameter scans.

entries.name: core-python-agent
entries.description: A reusable worker agent for RDKit cheminformatics and general Python execution. Writes and runs Python scripts for molecular manipulation, 2D/3D conformer generation, chemical property calculations, and scientific computing.

entries.name: cp2k
entries.description: Expert agent for atomistic simulations using CP2K. Designs and executes DFT calculations with geometry optimization, ab initio MD, vibrational analysis, band structure, NEB, and semi-empirical methods.

entries.name: crest
entries.description: Expert agent for conformational sampling and molecular chemical space exploration using CREST 3.0 with GFN-xTB semiempirical methods.

entries.name: dftbplus
entries.description: Density-functional tight-binding: fast approximate quantum simulations of large molecular and periodic systems on CPU.

entries.name: dssp
entries.description: Assign protein secondary structure (helices, sheets, turns) from 3D coordinates using the classic Kabsch- Sander DSSP algorithm.

entries.name: ensembl
entries.description: Query Ensembl for genes, transcripts, variants, and cross-references across many species via the Ensembl REST API.

entries.name: esm-embed
entries.description: Generate per-residue and per-sequence embeddings from protein sequences using Meta AI's ESM-2 transformer protein language models (8M to 650M parameters). Supports mean-pooled sequence embeddings, per-residue embeddings, and contact map predictions. GPU-accelerated via PyTorch + CUDA, with automatic CPU fallback.

entries.name: foldseek
entries.description: Ultra-fast protein structure search and structural alignment, scaling structural comparison to millions of entries on CPU.

entries.name: fpocket
entries.description: Geometry-based detection of ligand-binding pockets and cavities on protein structures using Voronoi tessellation and alpha spheres.

entries.name: freesasa
entries.description: Compute solvent-accessible surface area (SASA) of proteins with the Shrake-Rupley and Lee-Richards algorithms, per-atom and per-residue.

entries.name: gromacs
entries.description: Python code environment with Gromacs tool for high-performance molecular dynamics (MD) simulations.

entries.name: gwp-predictor
entries.description: Predicts 100-year Global Warming Potential (GWP100) and atmospheric lifetime (years) for novel molecules from SMILES. Multi-task Chemprop ensemble trained on IPCC AR6 + Hodnebrog 2020 + WMO 2022 with applicability-domain flagging (Tanimoto NN to training set) and OPERA AOH lifetime cross-check. Returns calibrated 95% confidence intervals.

entries.name: hmmer
entries.description: Profile hidden Markov model search for sensitive detection of remote homologs and protein domains (Pfam- style).

entries.name: iqtree
entries.description: Maximum-likelihood phylogenetic inference with automatic substitution model selection (ModelFinder) and ultrafast bootstrap support.

entries.name: janus
entries.description: De novo molecule generator wrapping the JANUS algorithm (Nigam et al., Digital Discovery 2022): a parallel-tempered SELFIES-based genetic algorithm with a DNN classifier guiding exploitation. SELFIES encoding guarantees 100% chemical validity. Accepts user-supplied fitness functions and optional custom filters (e.g. `make_pfas_filter()` for PFAS-free runs, applied as a hard post-filter). CPU-only, no bundled weights, no runtime internet.

entries.name: kegg
entries.description: Query the KEGG database for pathways, reactions, compounds, and genes via the public KEGG REST API.

entries.name: lammps
entries.description: Agent for orchestrating LAMMPS CPU tool for molecular simulations. Includes MDAnalysis, ASE, freud, and pandas for self-sufficient trajectory analysis and structure manipulation.

entries.name: matchms
entries.description: Import, process, and compute similarity between tandem mass spectra for metabolomics and small-molecule identification.

entries.name: materials-project
entries.description: Query the Materials Project database for computed properties of inorganic materials via the mp-api client.

entries.name: matminer
entries.description: Data mining for materials science: featurize compositions and crystal structures into descriptors for machine learning.

entries.name: mattergen
entries.description: Generative AI agent for inorganic crystal structure design using MatterGen (Zeni et al., Nature 2025). Generates novel, stable crystal structures unconditionally or conditioned on target properties including chemical composition, space group, band gap, magnetic density, and bulk modulus. Supports 9 pretrained models from the HuggingFace Hub.

entries.name: mdanalysis
entries.description: Analyze molecular dynamics trajectories from GROMACS, AMBER, NAMD, LAMMPS and more. Computes RMSD, RMSF, radius of gyration, and structural properties over time.

entries.name: mmseqs2
entries.description: Ultra-fast and sensitive sequence search and clustering for huge protein and nucleotide datasets, running efficiently on CPU.

entries.name: modeller
entries.description: Comparative (homology) modeling of protein 3D structure from a sequence alignment to one or more template structures.

entries.name: mol-toolkit
entries.description: Agent dedicated to cheminformatics.

entries.name: molecular-groups
entries.description: Expert agent for identifying functional groups in molecular structures. Provides both general functional group analysis and safety screening for hazardous groups.

entries.name: mordred
entries.description: Compute over 1800 2D and 3D molecular descriptors from SMILES for QSAR and machine-learning feature generation.

entries.name: msa-align
entries.description: Multiple sequence alignment via MAFFT, MUSCLE, or Clustal Omega for protein and nucleotide sequences.

entries.name: nmrglue
entries.description: Read, process, and analyze NMR data from Bruker, Varian/Agilent, and NMRPipe formats. Extract spectra and basic processing metadata.

entries.name: nucleotide-tf
entries.description: Expert agent for DNA sequence analysis using InstaDeep's Nucleotide Transformer v2 foundation model. Extracts rich embeddings, predicts masked nucleotides for variant effect scoring, and supports similarity, clustering, and visualization.

entries.name: online-researcher
entries.description: Expert research agent for conducting state-of-the-art literature reviews and research analyses in scientific, engineering, and medical fields. LLM-only agent with no attached computation tools.

entries.name: openbabel
entries.description: Universal chemical toolbox for interconverting 100+ chemical file formats, generating 3D coordinates, and computing molecular descriptors and fingerprints.

entries.name: openfoam
entries.description: Generalizable CFD agent powered by OpenFOAM. Infers simulation scenarios from natural language prompts, maps physical parameters, executes steady-state and transient solvers, and extracts quantitative metrics (drag, pressure drop, heat transfer, etc.) reported directly in chat. Supports internal flows, external aerodynamics, heat transfer, and rotating machinery via MRF.

entries.name: openmm
entries.description: Expert agent for GPU-accelerated molecular dynamics simulations using OpenMM. Handles PDB preparation, system building, energy minimization, equilibration, production MD, and trajectory analysis.

entries.name: opensta
entries.description: Static timing analysis for gate-level Verilog netlists using OpenSTA. Supports SKY130 and GF180MCU technology nodes with built-in liberty models. Auto-generates SDC constraints when not provided by the user.

entries.name: opsin
entries.description: Open Parser for Systematic IUPAC Nomenclature: convert chemical names into structures (SMILES/InChI/CML).

entries.name: p2rank
entries.description: Machine-learning prediction of ligand-binding sites from protein structure. Fast, template-free, and CPU-only (Java).

entries.name: patent-prior-art
entries.description: Expert agent for patent prior-art stress testing and claim analysis. Performs claim-centric prior art analysis with atomic element decomposition, evidence mapping, coverage ratings, and executive risk summaries.

entries.name: pdb-insights
entries.description: Advanced agent for comprehensive PDB structure analysis. Uses modern API to search RCSB PDB by UniProt ID, analyze quality metrics, biological assemblies, domain coverage, and binding partners.

entries.name: pdb-search
entries.description: Tool for managing and analyzing protein structure data from the RCSB PDB. Search, download, and process protein structures.

entries.name: phonopy
entries.description: Phonon and lattice-dynamics analysis from force constants produced by DFT codes: band structures, DOS, and thermal properties.

entries.name: plip
entries.description: Detect and characterize non-covalent protein-ligand interactions (hydrogen bonds, hydrophobic contacts, pi- stacking, salt bridges) from complex structures.

entries.name: prody
entries.description: Protein dynamics analysis: elastic network models and normal-mode analysis (ANM/GNM) to study collective motions without MD.

entries.name: psi4
entries.description: Python code environment with Psi4 for ab initio quantum chemistry calculations. HF, DFT, post-HF methods, SAPT, excited states, geometry optimization, frequency analysis, and thermochemistry.

entries.name: pubchem
entries.description: Tool for accessing chemical information from the PubChem database using the PubChem API.

entries.name: pubmed
entries.description: Tool for accessing biomedical literature from PubMed. Search and download articles, citations, and full-text content using PubMed/NCBI API. Includes PMC integration for open access articles.

entries.name: pymatgen
entries.description: Materials analysis library (the engine behind the Materials Project). Analyzes crystal structures, symmetry, densities, and generates I/O for common DFT codes.

entries.name: pyopenms
entries.description: Mass-spectrometry data processing for proteomics and metabolomics: read mzML, inspect spectra, and extract peak/feature information.

entries.name: pyscf
entries.description: Python-based ab initio quantum chemistry. Runs Hartree-Fock and DFT single-point energies and geometry properties for small molecules on CPU.

entries.name: quantum-espresso
entries.description: Python code environment with Quantum ESPRESSO for first-principles electronic structure calculations and materials modeling. Includes pymatgen, phonopy, seekpath, and ASE.

entries.name: rdock
entries.description: Open-source molecular docking for protein-ligand and protein-nucleic acid complexes, with fast CPU-based scoring and pose generation.

entries.name: retrochimera
entries.description: Expert agent for retrosynthetic analysis using the RetroChimera model (Maziarz et al., 2025). Ensembles template-based and de novo models with complementary inductive biases to predict single-step retrosynthetic disconnections and multi-step synthesis routes. Pre-loaded with the Pistachio-trained checkpoint (strongest model).

entries.name: rfdiffusion
entries.description: Expert agent for protein backbone design using the RFDiffusion denoising diffusion model. Supports unconditional generation, binder design, motif scaffolding, and symmetric oligomers.

entries.name: rnaseq
entries.description: Agent for RNA-seq differential expression analysis. Supports count matrix processing, statistical testing, volcano plot generation, gene ontology enrichment, and pathway analysis for transcriptomics experiments.

entries.name: rtl-ivlg-linter
entries.description: Agent that checks Verilog RTL syntax with the iverilog tool and, when errors are found, automatically fixes them while preserving design intent. Powered by Icarus Verilog (iverilog v12).

entries.name: rtl-yosys-syn
entries.description: Open-source Verilog RTL synthesis agent powered by Yosys. Synthesizes Verilog designs to gate-level netlists targeting SKY130 or GF180MCU ASIC technology nodes. Produces netlists and synthesis reports with cell count and area statistics.

entries.name: rxnmapper
entries.description: Atom-atom mapping of chemical reactions using an attention-based transformer. Runs on CPU for reaction SMILES.

entries.name: samtools-suite
entries.description: Manipulate high-throughput sequencing alignments (SAM/BAM/CRAM) and variant calls (VCF/BCF): sorting, indexing, statistics, and filtering.

entries.name: sirius
entries.description: Metabolite structure elucidation from tandem mass spectra: molecular formula identification and structure ranking (CSI:FingerID).

entries.name: spglib
entries.description: Crystal symmetry analysis: find space groups, symmetry operations, standardized cells, and Wyckoff positions.

entries.name: stat-agent
entries.description: Statistical validation agent for experimental data analysis. Provides hypothesis testing, power analysis, effect size estimation, multiple comparison correction, and distribution fitting for scientific datasets.

entries.name: synthesize-bio
entries.description: Generate gene expression from a virtual human. Describe any experiment — "tumor vs normal lung tissue" or "KRAS knockout vs control" — and Synthesize Bio generates realistic human expression profiles using its Gene Expression Model (GEM). Supports bulk and single-cell RNA-seq modalities.

entries.name: tamgen
entries.description: Target-aware molecular generation agent. Generates drug-like molecules conditioned on protein pocket structures using deep generative models with GPU acceleration.

entries.name: tellurium
entries.description: Simulate and analyze SBML/Antimony kinetic models of biochemical networks with the libRoadRunner ODE engine.

entries.name: tmalign
entries.description: Sequence-order-independent protein structural superposition returning TM-score and RMSD for pairwise structure comparison.

entries.name: toxpred
entries.description: Toxicity prediction agent for chemical compounds. Predicts multiple toxicity endpoints including acute toxicity, mutagenicity, carcinogenicity, and organ-specific effects from molecular structures.

entries.name: uniprot
entries.description: Query the UniProt knowledgebase for protein sequences, functional annotations, and cross-references via its public REST API.

entries.name: viennarna
entries.description: RNA secondary-structure prediction and thermodynamics: minimum free energy folding, partition functions, and base-pair probabilities.

entries.name: wiley-nexus
entries.description: Answers scientific and technical questions from Wiley's peer-reviewed scholarly corpus via the Wiley Nexus MCP server. Surveys published evidence from multiple angles, reads key publications in full, and returns a citation-backed synthesis with IEEE references linked to Wiley Online Library, then handles follow-ups in the same conversation. Includes an optional three-agent Discovery Engine pipeline for per-paper full-text analysis. Requires a Wiley Nexus API key.

entries.name: xyce
entries.description: SPICE circuit simulation using the Xyce parallel electronic simulator. Supports transient, DC, AC, and noise analyses. Includes SKY130 and GF180MCU transistor PDK models. Auto-generates testbenches when not provided by the user.

entries.name: zinc
entries.description: Agent for searching and retrieving molecular structures from the ZINC22 / CartBlanche database of commercially available compounds. Provides access to 37B+ substances with vendor availability, molecular properties, and SMILES-based exact/similarity search.
